newsitem.title: UK: UK/Cont clean tanker transatlantic rates firm.
newsitem.headline: UK/Cont clean tanker transatlantic rates firm.

text.p: Clean tanker rates for 60,000 tonne ships sailing transatlantic routes were firm on Friday as charterers with arbitrage barrels chased scarce cargoes, shipping brokers said.

While Neste fixed the 60,000 tonne Bona Favour for the end of the month at a hefty W125, brokers said rates were now above that level with one player seeking W140 for a similarly sized vessel. "There is simply a scarcity of ships," one said.
Ventspils/UKCont rates were up, too, with 60,000 tonners valued at around W117/120, compared with W107 a few days ago. Smaller 25,000 tonne gas oil stems were valued close to W180.
Caribbean markets remain well supplied with tonnage, relative to demand, and rates for 30,000 tonne vessels are stuck in the W175/180 range.
Cross-Med rates for 30,000 tonne gas oil vessels remain weak at W140.

Middle eastern rates for eastwards routes were slack too, with a surplus of MR tonnage depressing levels. Cargoes of 30,000 tonnes for India were valued at W185 and 55,000 tonne tankers headed for Japan were worth W195 or so. But with scarce tonnage of this size on offer, rates were thought likely to rise next week.
